semantic_models.name: order_facts
semantic_models.description: 订单粒度事实语义模型，一行一笔订单；通过左连接会员表补充会员归属门店，用于订单指标按成交门店与会员归属门店分别分组。

measures.name: order_record_count
measures.description: 全部订单记录数，按订单号计一次。

measures.name: paid_order_record_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: valid_order_record_count
measures.description: paid 且实付减退款大于零的订单记录数。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: cancelled_order_record_count
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: refund_order_record_count
measures.description: paid 且退款金额大于零的订单记录数。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: partial_refund_order_record_count
measures.description: paid 且退款大于零且小于实付的订单记录数。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 AND refund_cents < paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: full_refund_order_record_count
measures.description: paid 且实付大于零且退款等于实付的订单记录数。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > 0 AND refund_cents = paid_cents THEN 1 ELSE 0 END

measures.name: paid_amount_cents
measures.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，未扣退款，单位分。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: refund_amount_cents
measures.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，单位分。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: net_sales_amount_cents
measures.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计，取消单不计，单位分。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN paid_cents - refund_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: gross_amount_cents
measures.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计，单位分。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: discount_amount_cents
measures.description: paid 订单原价减实付的优惠金额合计，退款不冲减原优惠金额，单位分。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN gross_cents - paid_cents ELSE 0 END

measures.name: valid_buyer_count
measures.description: 有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: refund_buyer_count
measures.description: 发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND refund_cents > 0 THEN member_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: valid_selling_store_count
measures.description: 至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单成交门店数。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN store_id ELSE NULL END

measures.name: valid_order_item_count
measures.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计。
measures.expr: CASE WHEN status = 'paid' AND paid_cents > refund_cents THEN quantity ELSE 0 END

semantic_models.name: member_accounts
semantic_models.description: CRM 会员账户粒度语义模型，一行一个账户；账户不等同于跨系统自然人。

semantic_models.name: order_store_dim
semantic_models.description: 成交门店维度语义模型，提供订单成交门店的地区与名称。

semantic_models.name: member_home_store_dim
semantic_models.description: 会员归属门店维度语义模型，提供会员归属门店的地区与名称。

metrics.name: order_count
metrics.label: 创建订单数
metrics.description: 按下单日期统计全部订单，每个订单号一次，包含取消单。

metrics.name: paid_order_count
metrics.label: 支付订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 的订单数，包括后来全部退款的订单。

metrics.name: valid_order_count
metrics.label: 有效订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 paid 且实付金额减退款金额大于零的订单数；取消和全退不计。

metrics.name: cancelled_order_count
metrics.label: 取消订单数
metrics.description: 状态为 cancelled 的订单数。

metrics.name: refund_order_count
metrics.label: 退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款金额大于零的订单数，包括部分退款与全部退款。

metrics.name: partial_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 部分退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且退款大于零、小于实付金额的订单数。

metrics.name: full_refund_order_count
metrics.label: 全额退款订单数
metrics.description: paid 状态且实付大于零、退款等于实付的订单数。

metrics.name: payment_cents
metrics.label: 实付金额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付金额合计，尚未扣退款；单位分。

metrics.name: refund_cents
metrics.label: 退款金额
metrics.description: paid 订单退款金额合计，按原订单下单日期归属，不是现金退款发生日；单位分。

metrics.name: net_sales_cents
metrics.label: 净销售额
metrics.description: paid 订单实付减退款后合计；取消单不计；按原订单下单日期归属；单位分。

metrics.name: gross_cents
metrics.label: 支付订单原价金额
metrics.description: paid 订单折扣前原价金额合计；单位分。

metrics.name: discount_cents
metrics.label: 优惠金额
metrics.description: paid 订单原价减实付的金额合计；退款不冲减原优惠金额；单位分。

metrics.name: buyer_count
metrics.label: 购买会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口及筛选条件内有有效订单的不同 CRM 会员账户数，不做跨系统自然人去重。

metrics.name: refund_buyer_count
metrics.label: 退款会员数
metrics.description: 统计窗口内发生退款的 paid 订单关联的不同 CRM 会员账户数。

metrics.name: selling_store_count
metrics.label: 成交门店数
metrics.description: 窗口内至少有一笔有效订单的不同订单归属门店数。

metrics.name: valid_order_items
metrics.label: 有效订单商品件数
metrics.description: 有效订单中的原始购买件数合计；退款金额不能推算退货件数，此项不是净商品销量。

model_sql.order_facts: SELECT o.order_id, o.member_id, o.store_id, o.ordered_at, o.status, o.gross_cents, o.paid_cents, o.refund_cents, o.quantity, o.channel, m.home_store_id FROM {{ ref('orders') }} AS o LEFT JOIN {{ ref('members') }} AS m ON o.member_id = m.member_id
model_sql.order_store_dim: SELECT store_id, region, store_name FROM {{ ref('stores') }}
model_sql.member_home_store_dim: SELECT store_id AS home_store_id, region, store_name FROM {{ ref('stores') }}

business_model_usage.quote: 有效购买 | 订单为 paid，且实付减累计退款大于零；取消与全额退款不计 | 01、02
成交门店与会员归属门店不同，见 05
本期会员计数与资格判断的业务粒度；账户可持有多张卡
金额用整数分；退款按原订单下单日期归属；商品件数为有效订单的原始件数
账户不等于跨系统自然人
